reviewer_kind: AI-agent publication inspection, not human benchmark adjudication

main.method: Full-page renders, original figure exports and extracted text

supplement.method: Page-by-page layout inspection in contact sheets plus automated text/font/bounds checks on every page and exact 617-task dossier coverage

checks: Four standard main-paper figure captions with labels and independent panel explanations
True replay pixels present in all six panels after correcting paper crop bounds
Full/Mask share identical paper pixel window; global context retained
Global and source-scoped answer diagnostics have distinct panels and scales
No clipped content, missing figures, missing references or unembedded fonts
Two unnecessary supplement page breaks removed
All original question IDs occur exactly once as dossier headings
English prose and figure annotations; no private machine paths in PDFs
scope: Publication readability and evidence consistency. No visual answerability, physical feasibility or learned-model result is certified.
